subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the authority for the presenter: the same woman, her face, short black hair in a low bun, light-blue plain T-shirt, and the bright modern kitchen with the white marble island behind her.
<Picture 2> is the authority for the product: a 2-litre white plastic milk bottle with a blue screw cap, a built-in handle, and a green front label with the purple circular a2 logo, the words Full cream and 2L.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: identity_preserved. Face, hair, outfit and kitchen carry over; pose and framing follow this shot.
<Picture 2>: attribute_transfer. The bottle shape, blue cap, handle and green front label with the a2 logo carry over and stay legible; its plain white studio background does not.

detailed_description:
A vertical selfie-style medium shot at chest height in the kitchen. She carries a plain brown cardboard carton into frame and sets it down on the marble island in front of her, the carton's top flaps open so the blue caps of six identical bottles from <Picture 2> are visible inside. She grins at the lens and says teasingly and quickly, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 我老公问我是不是发财了，一下买这么多奶，</d> then leans in, lowers her voice with a playful shrug, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 他不知道，</d> and lifts one bottle out of the carton, turning its green front label to the camera as she says brightly, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 这是A二全脂牛奶。</d>

soundscape: her clear close-mic Mandarin voice, a soft thud of the carton on marble, a light plastic knock as the bottle is lifted, quiet kitchen room tone. No music.

No subtitles, captions, watermarks or extra text anywhere; the only printing is the front label from <Picture 2> on each bottle, kept stable. The carton is plain brown with no printing. No other brands. No extra fingers, no distorted hands, the bottle keeps its exact shape. No morphing, no cuts, no camera movement beyond slight handheld sway.

soundscape: her close off-screen Mandarin voice, a soft fingertip tap on the plastic label for each point, quiet kitchen room tone. No music.

A vertical selfie-style medium shot at chest height. An empty clear drinking glass stands on the marble island in front of her beside the open carton. She holds the bottle from <Picture 2> by its handle, already uncapped, and says earnestly, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 要知道他家的奶天然不含A一蛋白，</d> then tilts the bottle and pours a smooth steady stream of white milk into the glass, the glass filling about three-quarters, and while pouring says clearly, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 每百毫升蛋白质就有三点三克。</d> She sets the bottle down, front label toward the lens, and lifts the full glass toward the camera with a satisfied smile.

soundscape: her clear close-mic Mandarin voice, the gentle glug of milk pouring into glass, quiet kitchen room tone. No music.

No subtitles, captions, watermarks or extra text anywhere; the only printing is the front label from <Picture 2>, kept stable. No other brands. The milk stream is continuous, never spilling or splashing out of the glass; milk level only rises. No extra fingers, no distorted hands or face, no duplicated bottles in her hand.
